evidence.quote: In store and online, Tractor Supply provides what customers need
Tractor Supply is the largest rural lifestyle retailer in the U.S.
The Home Improvement & Furnishings category includes purchases in a wide variety of merchant categories including: home supply warehouse stores, lumber and building materials stores
Home Improvement Store purchases include online and in-store purchases at home improvement retail stores, building supply stores (e.g., lumber, paint and hardware stores)

draft.notes: No merchant-code lookup or issuer statement explicitly classifies Tractor Supply. Home-improvement is inferred from its rural-lifestyle retail business and the issuer definitions covering home-supply, hardware, building-supply, and related stores.
